title: Brazilian Steak with Croute Crust
description: A flavorful Brazilian-inspired steak dish with a crispy croute crust. Perfect for a hearty dinner.

ingredients.name: croute (gluten-free crackers or bread)
ingredients.notes: crushed or crushed and mixed with butter

instructions: Season the steak with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over high heat. Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the steak to a baking sheet and top with crushed croute.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes or until the croute is golden brown and the steak reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
